We spent the past year porting XENOTILT to Nintendo Switch, Xbox, PS5, as well as prepping the recently announced physical version for Switch and PS5 being published through Limited Run Games.

Along the way there was an assortment of bug fixes, polish and especially performance related issues that we're cleaned up. Specifically Steam Deck should see a performance boost it always ran well but this should be better. Laptops and Low Spec machines should also see an increase.

releases.displayName: Minor Fixes, and Tweaks to EX-Mode HUD

items.text: A small update here--a lot of the bug reports about not collecting tokens in EX-Mode may be due to confusion on how the system works due to there being no HUD representation of tokens gained and your progress towards earning one. So we've remedied that with some token status bars at the bottom of the HUD in EX-Mode.

Oh, we also updated to the latest Steam SDK. Perhaps that might fix some people's occasional hangs on startup--whenever we looked at the crash logs, a lot of them were inside the steam api DLL. So this might clean some of those up.

releases.displayName: EXCLUSIVE OR WINDOWED FULLSCREEN....THAT IS THE QUESTION

items.text: So it appears a few users are having issues with the game using exclusive full screen--it will crash on start up. So, I made the game use windowed full screen. Which looks the same and in theory should not impact performance. Can people let us know if this has impacted performance or if you prefer an actual exclusive full screen option? If so, I may add an additional toggle for exclusive full screen. But I ran it and I saw no performance difference.
-Fixing Ball in Matrix Inserter/Fork errantly sending to Trough after timing out.
-Matrix Inserter/Fork should not allow you to drop in the wrong column so easily.
-Balls Accidently stuck in Matrix when Column is full/occupied cup should return to trough.
-Fixed ball stuck in Hera's Collar Spikes.

Ok, so our ball stuck detector is a bit TOO good and was thinking balls were stuck in the matrix and warping them to the trough. We're working on this issue. Now the ball won't warp away--but let us know if you see the ball stuck anywhere. Post screenshots of where the ball is stuck. We thoroughly stress tested the game and removed pretty much all the parts of the table that would get the ball stuck...but you never know!

Ok the language button no longer sets your resolution incorrectly--the language button was accidentally hooked up to some old obsolete resolution selection code rather than language selection code. Thanks to all you Early Access players for spotting this one!!
And remember, if you are stuck in a bad res--go to the option screen, hold LEFT ALT and press 0--it will set it back to 1080p.

notes.title: Ok so here's ANOTHER hotfix. Here's what we've done

items.text: * Complete localization. There should be no broken strings
* No erroneous tilt bobs in scoreboards -- we're hiding them until we fix that
* PG UP / PG DN works in scoreboards
* Hardcore Xenoslayer achievement works (I think?!!?)

* You shouldn't be able to get into a 4:3 res. But if so, there's an EMERGENCY RESOLUTIONR RESET key sequence: If you are in the options menu, hold ALT and press 0. It will reset the resolution to 1080p. This way you don't have to edit the registry if you somehow get stuck in a weird resolution.
